## Biography

Meher is an undergraduate studying Biology with a minor in Childhood Studies. She is passionate about working with children and hopes to pursue a career in pediatric medicine in the future. Through her studies and experiences, she is interested in learning more about how communication plays a role in children’s development and well-being. Outside of academics, she enjoys playing pickleball, reading, and spending time with friends and family.
